setting: # The ELS calendar (Evangelical Lutheran Hymnary).  Any setting from config.csv may
# be given here and wins over it for this tradition; a row with a variant
# applies to that series only.  See docs/traditions.md.
# The one-year series opens with its Sundays' Latin names (the page's box
# and new_year.py when --latin-names / --no-latin-names is not given).
# The three-year series begins with Year A at Advent 2025 (reading_cycle).

# Hymnary.org's code for the Evangelical Lutheran Hymnary (1996): a hymn mark after each set of readings searches it for the hymns on them (hymnary.org/hymnal/ELH1996). Few of its hymns have their scripture there yet.
